items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: But, when I come into the band -- Jimmy Rushing -- I thought he was real funny.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean, Jimmy -- in fact from this thing, Jimmy was with Basie before Basie even -- Jimmy and Basie were working on a session or a gig or something before Basie even ever did lead a band.

Yeah. As far as I know, they had been friends for many years. But, when I come into the band -- Jimmy Rushing -- I thought he was real funny. He had so many different stories that he could tell and keep everything going and keep everything alive and funny, you know.
